text:
tara (compliance): Auditor asked for an evidence bundle for the emergency RBAC exception during 2026-04-02 incident. Need artifact manifest + control mapping for SOC2/ISO.

noah (oncall): tagging @saira @devops_olga. Which artifacts prove approval, who executed the change, and KMS access? I can provide the kubectl outputs.

saira (secops): We have: JIRA-5598 approval comment, GitOps PR 518 showing the RoleBinding, CloudTrail KMS Decrypt entries, and the Vault request approval. I'll export filtered CT entries.

devops_olga: I'll stage sanitized exports to s3://redwood-evidence/1798500001/incident-2026-04-02/ and include `pr-518-diff.patch` and `kubectl-create.txt`. Redacting IPs and STS tokens.

auditor_mark: Include DescribeKey snapshot, key policy at time-of-incident, GetKeyRotationStatus output, and NDJSON of Decrypt calls with principal and requestId. Also need checksums and a signed chain-of-custody listing handlers.

packbot: packaging started  added: `cloudtrail-kms-1798500001.ndjson`, `jira-5598.pdf`, `pr-518-diff.patch`, `kms-describe-logs.json`. bundle ~9MB.

tara (compliance): I'll draft a one-line mapping per artifact to controls (e.g., `cloudtrail-kms-*.ndjson -> CC6.2 / A.10.1`) and produce the manifest with SHA256 checksums and redaction notes. Expect draft in ~20m.

noah (oncall): I removed the RoleBinding after 90min. I'll attach `kubectl delete` output and timestamp.

auditor_mark: Received presigned bundle when ready; will review within 48h. Thanks.

packbot: bundle complete  presigned URL (7d): <redacted-url>  manifest `coc-manifest-1798500001.json` included.
